subject: Request: Promo stipend & custom billing for accelerator cohort pilot
messages:
From: Samira Voss <samira@olivelabs.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Promo stipend & custom billing for accelerator cohort pilot

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and the KV caching suggestions. We're preparing to run a pilot in our accelerator cohort (5 → expanding to ~20 active developers over 6 weeks) and wanted to confirm whether we can: 

- Stack the onboarding promo stipend you've extended to other cohorts, or request an additional one-off pilot stipend for this expanded cohort.
- Defer initial invoice by 30 days while we process a PO in our procurement system.
- Get a short-term packaged rate for the pilot that scales to our committed paid plan if we convert.

To be candid: if we can get a controlled stipend + 30-day invoicing window, we can push several teams through Redwood this quarter and convert to paid next quarter.

Can you share what exceptions are possible and any docs you need from us (SOW, PO number, security checks)?

Appreciate it —
Samira Voss
Founder, Olive Labs
attach: accelerator_scope.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Voss <samira@olivelabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Promo stipend & custom billing for accelerator cohort pilot

Hi Samira — great to hear the demo landed well.

Short answer: we can make a tailored onboarding path work for Olive Labs. Proposed approach below so we can move quickly: 

1) Stipend structure (pilot-only):
   - 30% onboarding stipend applied to first 3 months' consumption (capped at $12k equivalent).
   - Milestone top-ups: additional $3k credit if >10 devs active within 30 days.

2) Billing terms:
   - Invoice issued at the end of month 1, payable Net 30. We can accept a PO reference to trigger the invoice.

3) Conversion path to paid plan:
   - If Olive converts within 90 days, we will honor a 15% transition discount for the first 3 paid months.

What I need from you to approve internally:
- A short SOW or pilot scope (1 page).
- Procurement contact and intended PO number or expected PO timeline.

I attached a one-page pricing summary (pricing_summary_v2.pdf) and a draft MOU for the stipend (redwood-pricing-stipend-mou.pdf). If that looks good to you, sign the MOU in DocuSign and we can issue the stipend and set up the billing.

Thanks — copying Ben (finance) and Monica (CS) so they have context.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
attach: pricing_summary_v2.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-pricing-stipend-mou.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:46:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Promo stipend & custom billing for accelerator cohort pilot

Laura / Monica — quick internal note on finance constraints and an approval path. Quoting Samira's ask below for context.

I can greenlight a pilot stipend that matches Laura's proposal with these guardrails: 
- Total promotional exposure capped at $15k gross per account for accelerator cohorts without an explicit revenue commitment.
- Require PO or valid billing contact before we ship credits. We will set the initial invoice Net 30 to align with their procurement ask; do not start usage credits until the signed MOU is in our system.
- If Olive requests further stacking (multiple stipend packages), route to commercial for a bespoke contract (preferred if >$15k).

Monica — please prepare a quick onboarding checklist (1 pager) that includes: account owners, expected active dev list, conversion milestones, and recommended observability hooks we want enabled so we can measure success.

If procurement returns with PO, finance will accept Net 30 as long as we have the signed MOU and a billing contact.

Ben
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

On Mon, 9 Aug 2027 at 14:23 Samira Voss <samira@olivelabs.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week...

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Voss <samira@olivelabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, finance@olivelabs.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Promo stipend & custom billing for accelerator cohort pilot

Samira — thanks, we discussed internally and can proceed on the terms below once we have the signed MOU and PO details: 

- Pilot stipend: 30% onboarding stipend applied to first 3 months (cap $12k).
- Milestone top-up: $3k credit if >10 devs active in 30 days.
- Billing: Invoice at EOM, Net 30; we will accept an initial PO reference to generate the invoice.
- Security: we received your request for SOC2 evidence — attached is a summary (SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf). If your security team needs more, send the contact and we'll coordinate the full package.

Next steps: 
1) Review and e-sign the MOU here: https://www.docusign.com/OLV-4921/mou
2) Share PO number or procurement timeline so finance can queue the invoice.
3) Monica will send the onboarding checklist and schedule a kickoff for next week once the MOU is signed.

If you want the stipend increased or to stack with another program, we'll need a short commercial review — Ben can start that once we have usage forecasts.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Laura
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
attach: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-pricing-stipend-mou.pdf (application/pdf)
